derivation: from a derivative of G5180 (τύπτω) (meaning a drum, "tympanum");
def: to stretch on an instrument of torture resembling a drum, and thus beat to death

occurrences.text: Women received their dead raised to life again: and others were tortured, not accepting deliverance; that they might obtain a better resurrection:
